design.allocation: Equal BTC and ETH initial target shares within crypto fraction, rest cash. Preselected globally, no future-window information or selection among results.
design.windows: All same 47 monthly starts / 12 calendar months; unchanged S3 baseline reused with hash checks.
design.execution: Inherited ETH initial inventory; one rebalance at next daily open using prior close quantities, original fees/friction/minimums; then hold quantities. Target shares approximate due costs/gaps/precision; weights drift. No end liquidation.
design.interpretation: Ex-ante weight rule on adaptively reused development data, not unseen evidence. Fixed exposure levels are not exact realized exposure or risk matching. Report all three, never select best control.
design.protection: No S3 rerun, threshold tuning, new signal hypotheses, holdout or promotion.

settings.capital_note: Illustrative starting inventory, editable, not a capital constraint. Quote equity uses the actual first scored ETH price, not a fixed ETH/USDC conversion.
settings.model: daily candle screening proxy, not observed execution
settings.rules_scope: Static candidate Bitvavo USDC rules observed 2026-11-12; prospective-cost proxy, not historical rule reconstruction or authenticated account settings. Applied to USD-source experiments only as an explicitly hypothetical execution scenario.
